blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We identify a potential bottleneck in diffusion editors: many methods provide limited reference-attention allocation. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1 % 1\% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.
blocks.zh: 参考指南的传播编辑者努力忠实地复制用户提供的参考资料。 我们找出了传播编辑器中潜在的瓶颈:许多方法提供的参考资料分配有限。 例如,在LoomVideo中,编辑-区域查询为引用分配的注意力质量不到1% 。 我们引入了RefGAP,这是一种无训练的校正,它从前方行驶时测得的参考值质量中确定每层在线的对数抵消量。 引用日志的正偏移通过编辑区域查询加强引用使用,而保留区域查询的负偏移则限制编辑外引用引起的变化. 两个全局系数控制校正;它们从四个开发传播编辑器的验证数据中选取一次,并被固定. 在7个基于传播的图像/视频编辑器中,RefGAP提高了头部交换和面部交换中的身份忠诚度。 RefGAP实现忠贞-保全的权衡,与单独调制的恒定编辑侧偏差相当,不逐方进行强度扫描. 关于虚拟试运行和背景替换的其他实验评价超出身份编辑范围的传输.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern diffusion editors can condition on a user-provided reference image to edit a driving image or video, supporting tasks such as head swapping, face swapping, virtual try-on, and background replacement. Many recent systems adopt an in-context design ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , in which reference tokens share the denoiser’s attention sequence with the content being edited. Yet direct access to the reference does not guarantee fidelity.
blocks.zh: 现代的传播编辑器可以以用户提供的参考图像为条件来编辑驱动图像或视频,支持头部互换,面部互换,虚拟试播,背景替换等任务. 许多最近的系统采用了内文字设计(Jiang等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年a; Wu et al., 2025b; Black Forest Labs, 2025 ),其中参考符号与内容编辑时分享denoiser的注意力序列. 然而,直接查阅参考文献并不能保证忠诚。

blocks.en: Existing methods strengthen reference conditioning through task-specific training ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) or training-free manipulation of reference attention or features ( Shin et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . However, inference-time interventions typically rely on fixed, empirically chosen coefficients that may require retuning across models or tasks. They do not explicitly couple reference-attention enhancement in edit regions with suppression in keep regions.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过任务特定培训(Wang等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年;Fang等人,2024年)或无培训操作参考注意力或特征,强化参考条件(Shin等人,2025年;Fan等人,2024年). 然而,推论时间干预通常依赖于固定的、经验性选择的、可能需要在模型或任务之间重新调整的系数。 它们没有明确将编辑区域的参考意向改进与保留区域的抑制结合起来。

blocks.en: We partition each attention layer’s keys into reference and rest tokens and compute the fraction ρ \rho of each query’s attention mass assigned to the reference ( fig. 2 ). Using an edit mask, we average ρ \rho separately over content queries in the edit and keep regions. The profiles reveal two patterns: some approaches exhibit substantially higher reference attention in edit versus keep regions within a localized layer band, typically in the network’s second half; others assign little reference attention to edit queries across many layers, falling below 1 % 1\% on LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . These patterns motivate selective layer intervention, while ρ \rho provides an online signal for correction strength.
blocks.zh: 我们将每个注意层的密钥分割成参考符,并休息符号,计算每个查询的注意质量(图)的分数 $\rho。 2 。 使用编辑掩码, 我们平均在编辑时对内容查询分别进行\rho, 并保留区域 。 简介揭示了两种模式:一些方法在编辑中显示的参考关注要高得多,而将区域保持在局部层区域范围内,通常在网络的下半部分;其他方法则很少对多层的编辑询问给予参考关注,在LoomVideo(Wu等人,2026年)上低于1%。 这些模式激励了选择性的层层干预,而 $\rho 则为校正强度提供了在线信号.

blocks.en: Based on this measurement, we introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction named after the reference-attention gap it aims to bridge. Within a single forward pass, using statistics already produced by the attention computation, RefGAP reads the reference-attention masses in both regions and adds one scalar to every reference-key logit: a positive offset for edit-region queries, so they read the reference more, and a negative offset for keep-region queries, so the stronger reference signal does not pull the preserved content with it. The offset adapts to the measured reference-attention mass at each intervened layer and forward pass, reducing the need for model- or task-specific tuning.
blocks.zh: 基于这一计量,我们引入了RefGAP,这是一种无培训的校正,以它旨在弥补的参考-注意空白命名。 在一次前传中,RefGAP利用注意计算已经生成的统计数据,读取两个区域的参考关注量,并在每个参考键对数中增加一个标量:一个正偏移用于编辑-区域查询,所以它们读取更多参考值,一个负偏移用于保留区域查询,因此更强的参考信号不会用它拉动保存的内容. 抵消部分适应了每个干涉层和前传层的计量参考值质量,减少了对模型或任务特定调整的需要。

blocks.en: We calibrate two global coefficients and establish a shared layer-selection rule on four development approaches (JoyAI-Video-Edit ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , FLUX.2-klein and FLUX.2-klein-base ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) ) using 40 head-swap validation clips. We freeze the coefficients, thresholds, and rule before applying them to three held-out approaches. Each approach requires one validation profiling run to determine its layer set under the fixed rule; this set is reused across tasks without tuning. Identity similarity improves on head-swap and face-swap tasks. Without task-specific retuning, virtual try-on fidelity improves across seven approaches, while background replacement yields mixed results, including a clear degradation on Qwen-Image-Edit ( section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 校准两个全球系数,并针对四个开发方法(JoyAI-Video-Edit(Xiao等人,2026年),LoomVideo(Wu等人,2026年),FLUX.2-Klein和FLUX.2-Klein-base(Black Forest Labs,2025年))制定共享层选择规则,使用40个头游验证剪辑. 我们冻结系数、阈值和规则,然后把它们应用于三种搁置的办法。 每种方法都需要一个验证剖析运行,以确定其在固定规则下设置的层层;此集在不调谐的情况下跨任务重复使用. 身份相似性在头部擦拭和脸部擦拭任务上有所改进. 没有针对具体任务的重新调整,虚拟的尝试忠诚度在七种方法中都有提高,而背景替换则产生好坏参半的结果,包括在Quen-Image-Edit上的明显退化(第5节)。

blocks.en: To summarize, our contributions are: • We measure reference-attention mass for edit and keep queries, revealing approach-dependent allocation patterns and limited reference attention in several approaches. • We propose RefGAP, a training-free, two-sided attention correction that derives its per-layer strength online from the measured attention mass. RefGAP increases reference influence inside the edit while suppressing reference attention in the keep region. • We demonstrate cross-approach and cross-task transfer using a single configuration calibrated once on 40 head-swap validation clips. Without retuning, it consistently boosts identity fidelity across seven approaches in head and face swapping (alongside an attribute-preservation trade-off), transfers to virtual try-on, and delineates transfer boundaries with mixed results on background replacement.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们测量参考-注意量,以编辑和保存查询,揭示方法依赖的分配模式和若干方法的有限参考关注。 我们建议RefGAP,一种没有训练的,双面的注意力修正,它从量度的注意力量中从网络上获得它的每层力量. FRIGAP在编辑过程中增加参考影响力,同时在保存区域抑制参考关注. ^ 我们用一个单一的配置校准一次,在40个头部擦拭验证片段上演示跨面和跨任务传输. 它不重新调整,就始终促进在头面和脸面交换(与属性-保护权衡)的七种方法中保持身份忠诚,向虚拟尝试转让,并划定转让界限,在背景替换方面结果参差不齐。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Reference-guided editors incorporate visual conditions either as tokens in a shared attention sequence or through a separate conditioning branch. In-context systems such as VACE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , JoyAI-Video-Edit ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , OmniGen2 ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , and FLUX.2-klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) allow reference and content tokens to interact within joint attention. Decoupled methods inject reference features through cross-attention or additive branches, as in IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) . RefGAP targets the in-context setting, where reference and content tokens compete within the same softmax and their relative mass can be modified directly.
blocks.zh: 参考指南编辑将视觉条件作为符号纳入到一个共同的注意力序列中,或者通过一个单独的调节分支. VACE(Jiang等人,2025年),LoomVideo(Wu等人,2026年),JoyAI-Video-Edit(Xiao等人,2026年),Quen-Image-Edit(Wu等人,2025年a),OmniGen2(Wu等人,2025年b)和FLUX等内文系统. 2-klein(Black Forest Labs, 2025)允许参考和内容符号在共同关注范围内相互作用. 如IP-Adapter(Ye等人,2023年)中,脱钩方法通过交叉注意或添加剂分支注入参考特征。 RefGAP针对的是内文本设置,参考物和内容符在同一软马克斯内竞争,其相对质量可以直接修改.

blocks.en: Training-free diffusion methods manipulate attention to control conditioning and source consistency ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) . Diptych Prompting ( Shin et al., 2025 ) enhances attention from queries in the generated panel to keys in the reference panel. FreeCustom ( Ding et al., 2024 ) combines multi-reference self-attention with weighted concept masks to integrate and emphasize reference concepts for multi-concept composition. RefDrop ( Fan et al., 2024 ) controls consistency across generated images or video frames by mixing reference and self-attention outputs with a user-specified scalar shared across queries.
blocks.zh: 无培训传播方法操纵了对控制条件和源一致性的注意(Hertz等人,2022年;Cao等人,2023年)。 潜水员 提示(Shin等人,2025年)使生成的面板中的询问对参考面板中的密钥更加关注. FreeCustom(Ding等人,2024年)将多参考自觉与加权概念口罩相结合,整合并强调多概念构成的参考概念. RefDrop(Fan等人,2024年)控制生成的图像或视频帧的一致性,方法是将参考和自觉输出与用户指定的、在查询时共享的scalar混合。

blocks.en: These methods control reference influence through fixed or user-specified coefficients selected for a particular model or task. FreeCustom and RefDrop primarily target generation or consistency, without defining a region to preserve in an existing source image. Diptych also supports subject-driven editing through an edit mask, but its reference-attention boost remains uniform across queries in the edited panel. GRAG ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and DCAG ( Li, 2026 ) provide separate representation-level controls for editing strength through externally selected coefficients.
blocks.zh: 这些方法通过特定模型或任务选定的固定或用户指定系数来控制参考影响. FreeCustom和RefDrop主要针对生成或一致性,而没有定义一个区域以保存在现有源图像中. Diptych也支持通过编辑口罩进行主题驱动编辑,但其参引助推在编辑面板的查询之间仍然一致. GRAG(张等人,2026年)和DCAG(李,2026年)通过外部选择的系数为编辑强度提供单独的表示级别控制.

blocks.en: RefGAP determines logit-offset magnitudes online from reference attention measured separately for edit and keep queries. Positive offsets enhance reference attention in edit regions, while negative offsets suppress it in keep regions. After a single calibration, the same coefficients transfer to held-out approaches and additional tasks without further manual tuning.
blocks.zh: RefGAP从为编辑和保存查询而单独测量的参考注意力中在线确定对数抵消的星等. 积极抵消可以提高编辑区域对参考资料的注意,而消极抵消可以抑制区域参考。 经过一次校准后,同样的系数会转移到被搁置的方法和额外的任务上,而无需再进行人工调整.

blocks.en: 3.3 Two-sided reference correction
blocks.zh: 3.3 双面参考更正

blocks.en: To control reference-attention allocation, RefGAP adds a shared offset to the reference-key logits for each query group. This changes the total attention assigned to the reference while preserving the relative attention weights within each key group. The offset is positive for edit queries and negative for keep queries; its magnitude adapts to the corresponding measured reference mass.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluate seven diffusion editors: JoyAI-Video-Edit ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , FLUX.2-klein and FLUX.2-klein-base ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , VACE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , and OmniGen2 ( Wu et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价七个传播编辑器: JoyAI-Video-Edit(Xiao等人,2026年),LoomVideo(吴等人,2026年),FLUX.2-Klein和FLUX.2-Klein-base(黑林实验室,2025年),VACE(江等人,2025年),Quen-Image-Edit(吴等人,2025年a),OmniGen2(吴等人,2025年b).

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation focuses on head and face swapping. Head swapping uses the 1,040 test clips of HeadSwapBench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and face swapping uses the 1,000 official target-source pairs from the FaceSwap subset of FaceForensics++ ( Rossler et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的主要评价重点是头和脸的交换。 换头使用HeadSwap Bench的1040个测试片段(Wang等人,2025年),换头使用FaceForensics的FaceSwap子集1000个官方目标源对. (Rossler等人,2019年).

blocks.en: We further evaluate transfer beyond identity editing through virtual try-on and background replacement. Try-on uses 90 ViViD clips ( Fang et al., 2024 ) , with reference garments permuted within category. Background replacement uses 150 ground-truth videos from the HeadSwapBench test split as inputs, paired with 30 SUN397 scene references ( Xiao et al., 2010 ) . Across all four tasks, video approaches process video clips, while image approaches edit the middle frame of each clip.
blocks.zh: 我们通过虚拟尝试和背景替换,进一步评估身份编辑之外的转移。 Try-on使用90个ViViD剪辑(Fang等人,2024年),参考服装在类别中穿插. 背景替换使用来自HeadSwap Bench测试拆分的150个地面真实视频作为输入,配对为30个SUN397场景参考(Xiao等人,2010年). 在所有四项任务中,视频接近处理视频剪辑,而图像接近编辑每个剪辑的中框.

blocks.en: For head and face swapping, we report AdaFace identity similarity ( Kim et al., 2022 ) , keypoint error ( Lugaresi et al., 2019 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于头和脸互换,我们报告AdaFace身份相似性(Kim等人,2022年),关键点错误(Lugaresi等人,2019年),LPIPS(张等人,2018年).

blocks.en: For head swapping, Repl . \mathrm{Repl.} denotes the percentage of outputs whose generated face is closer in identity to the reference than to the input subject. Identity similarity is measured against the ground-truth video, and keypoint error is measured against the corresponding ground-truth frames.
blocks.zh: 对于头部交换,Repl.\mathrm{Repl.}表示其生成的面孔在身份上比输入主体更接近引用的输出百分比. 身份相似性根据地面真实视频进行测量,关键点错误根据相应的地面真实框架进行测量。

blocks.en: For face swapping, Repl . \mathrm{Repl.} is the percentage of outputs whose nearest identity in the 978 978 -identity FF++ gallery is no longer the input subject, and Retr . \mathrm{Retr.} is the percentage whose nearest identity is the reference. VACE’s masked driving video hides the input identity, so we omit Repl . \mathrm{Repl.} for VACE in both identity tasks. Identity similarity is measured against the reference face, whereas keypoint error is measured against the input (driving) video.
blocks.zh: 对于面值互换,Repl.\mathrm{repl.}是其最近的身份在978 978 - 身份 FF++ 画廊中不再作为输入主体的输出百分比,Retr. \ mathrm{ retr.} 是最近身份为引用的百分比 。 VACE的蒙面驱动视频隐藏了输入身份,因此在两个身份任务中都省略了Repl.\mathrm{Repl.}用于VACE. 身份相似性根据参考面来测量,而关键点错误则根据输入(驾驶)视频来测量.

blocks.en: For the main results, LPIPS uses task-specific preservation targets. For head swapping, it is computed over the whole frame against the ground-truth video. For face swapping, it is computed outside the face mask against the input video.
blocks.zh: 对于主要结果,LPIPS使用特定任务保存目标. 就换头而言,它是根据地面真实录像从整个框架计算出来的。 为了换脸,它是在面罩外对输入视频进行计算.

blocks.en: For virtual try-on and background replacement, we report region-specific DINOv2 similarity ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) to the reference image over the edited garment and background regions, respectively. LPIPS is computed outside the garment mask against the input for virtual try-on, and inside the person mask against the input for background replacement.
blocks.zh: 关于虚拟试运行和背景替换,我们分别报告区域特有的DINOv2相似性(Oquab等人,2023年)与编辑后的服装和背景区域的参考图像。 LPIPS是相对于虚拟尝试的输入在服装罩外进行计算,而人物面具内部则是相对于背景替换的输入.

Section G.2 shows that delaying correction to later denoising steps substantially reduces keypoint degradation while retaining identity gains over the base model.
blocks.zh: 关于头部交换,RefGAP将每种适用方法的替换率提高到至少86%的86+%,提高所有7种方法的特性相似性,不增加任何方法的全框架LPIPS,将其减少为4种,间隔时间不包括0(表14)。 关键点错误主要在JoyAI-Video-Edit,FLUX.2-klein,和FLUX.2-klein-base上增加. G.2节显示,推迟纠正到后来取消提名的步骤可大大减少关键点的退化,同时保留比基准模型的特性增益。

blocks.en: For face swapping, RefGAP improves identity similarity across all approaches, with replacement and correct retrieval rates reaching at least 82 % 82\% and 75 % 75\% , respectively. Keypoint error rises on most approaches, while non-face LPIPS varies by approach. Without ground-truth outputs, LPIPS compares against the input video, potentially counting identity-related geometry differences as preservation errors. Larger identity gains generally accompany larger keypoint changes ( section G.1 ).
blocks.zh: 就换脸而言,RefGAP改进了所有方法的特性相似性,替换率和正确的检索率分别达到至少82%、82%和75%。 大多数方法的键点错误上升,而非面的LPIPS则因方法而异. 没有地面真实输出,LPIPS与输入视频进行比较,可能将身份相关几何差异算作保存错误. 更大的身份增益一般伴随着较大的关键点变化(G.1节)。

blocks.en: With the same coefficients, RefGAP improves virtual try-on reference fidelity on all seven approaches ( table 2 , intervals excluding zero on four). Background replacement has a different objective from identity editing and try-on: the surrounding scene should change, while the foreground subject should remain unchanged. It improves on JoyAI-Video-Edit, LoomVideo, and OmniGen2, changes little on the FLUX.2 variants and VACE, and degrades on Qwen-Image-Edit ( table 14 ). These mixed results highlight that reference transfer remains task- and approach-dependent.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: The all-step default prioritizes reference identity and can compromise pose and expression preservation. Delaying correction can mitigate these costs: on JoyAI-Video-Edit and FLUX.2-klein, skipping the first correction step substantially reduces keypoint error while retaining identity improvements over the base. However, the required delay varies across sampling schedules, and stronger geometric preservation reduces identity gains ( table 19 ).
blocks.zh: 全步默认优先排序参考身份,并可以妥协姿势和表达保全. 延迟校正可以减轻这些费用:在JoyAI-Video-Edit和FLUX.2-klein上,跳过第一个校正步骤可以大幅降低键点错误,同时保留对底部的身份改进. 然而,所需延迟时间因取样时间表而异,加强几何保存会减少身份收益(表19)。

blocks.en: Despite broad gains in identity editing and virtual try-on, RefGAP reduces background fidelity on Qwen-Image-Edit. Restricting layer coverage does not resolve this degradation, suggesting that this approach-task pair may require a different correction strategy.
blocks.zh: 尽管在身份编辑和虚拟尝试上取得了广泛进展,但RefGAP在Quen-Image-Edit上降低了背景忠诚度. 限制层覆盖并不能解决这种退化问题,这表明这一方法任务组合可能需要不同的校正策略。

blocks.en: Applying RefGAP to a new approach requires one base-model profiling run on a validation split to select correction layers under the fixed rule. The coefficients and thresholds remain unchanged, and the selected layers are reused across tasks. This adds setup cost, although it avoids repeated evaluations over a grid of correction strengths.
blocks.zh: 将RefGAP应用到新的方法中,需要在验证分拆上运行一个基模剖面,以选择固定规则下的校正层. 系数和阈值保持不变,选定的层层在任务之间重复使用。 这增加了设置费用,虽然这避免了重复评价矫正力量。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce RefGAP, a training-free method that uses measured reference-attention mass to dynamically strengthen reference influence in edit regions and suppress it in keep regions. With two coefficients calibrated on four development approaches and a shared layer-selection rule, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head and face swapping across seven approaches, including three held-out ones. It achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to approach-specific constant edit-side biases without per-approach strength sweeps. Transfer without task-specific retuning yields positive fidelity gains in virtual try-on but mixed results in background replacement. Together, these results support measured attention as a practical signal for controlling reference influence, while leaving attribute preservation and reliable cross-task transfer as directions for further work.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了无培训参考参考参考软件(RefGAP),这是一种无培训方法,它使用量度参考参考量,在编辑区域大力加强参考影响力,在保留区域加以抑制。 通过对4种发展办法进行两个系数校准,并采用共同的层层选择规则,RefGAP改进了头部身份的忠诚度,并在7种办法(包括3种搁置办法)之间换脸。 它实现了忠贞-保全的权衡,与不逐一进行强度检查而采用特定方法的恒定编辑偏差相当。 没有特定任务调整的转让在虚拟试运行中产生积极的忠诚收益,但在背景替换中产生的结果好坏参半。 这些成果支持共同衡量了注意力,将其作为控制参考影响的一个实际信号,同时将属性保全和可靠的跨任务转移作为今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies reference-guided visual editing, including head and face swapping, which can be misused to fabricate media of real individuals. All images and videos used in our evaluation are drawn from public benchmarks (HeadSwapBench, FaceForensics++, ViViD, VITON-HD, and SUN397). We release no new identity data and neither train nor release a new model; our method is an inference-time modification of publicly released editors.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了参考指导的视觉编辑,包括头部和面部互换,这些可以被滥用来编织真实个人的媒体. 我们评价中使用的所有图像和视频都来自公共基准(HeadSwap Bench、FaceForensics++、ViViD、VITON-HD和SUN397)。 我们没有发布新的身份数据,既不训练也不发布新的模型;我们的方法是对公开发布的编辑的推论时间修改.

blocks.en: For the human evaluation, participants were undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral students with a background in computer vision. All participants provided informed consent before taking part. We collected their judgments of the editing results without collecting personally identifiable information.
blocks.zh: 就人类评价而言,参与者是本科生、硕士生和具有计算机视觉背景的博士生。 所有与会者在参加之前都提供了知情同意。 我们收集了他们对编辑结果的判断,而没有收集个人可识别的信息。

blocks.en: HeadSwapBench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) contains 1040 1040 test clips and a disjoint validation split of 40 40 clips. Each clip contains 121 121 frames at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution. Inputs comprise a driving video and a reference head image; VACE receives a head-masked driving video. Image approaches are edited and evaluated on the middle frame.

blocks.en: Because head swapping replaces the entire head, including the hair, whereas AdaFace focuses only on the face, we additionally report whole-head similarity ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which measures the cosine similarity between head-appearance embeddings of the generated result and the ground truth. Keypoint error uses 478 478 landmarks and is normalized by inter-ocular distance.

blocks.en: While the main paper evaluates general-purpose editors, we further apply RefGAP to a task-specific fine-tuned model. We evaluate DirectSwap ( Wang et al., 2025 ) in its released inference pipeline, including its attention-based background compositing. For this mask-free model, we define edit queries from the reference-attention mass of the first denoising step, averaged over all attention heads: in each of layers 8–26 (zero-based), a query casts a vote if its mass lies above the 0.7 quantile of its latent frame, and it is an edit query if more than 20% of these layers vote for it. These are the defaults of DirectSwap’s released background-compositing mask, so RefGAP adds no threshold of its own. The first step runs unmodified; the region is then fixed, and RefGAP acts on layers 15–29 for the remaining 29 of 30 sampling steps.
blocks.zh: 虽然主要论文评价通用编辑器,但我们进一步将RefGAP应用到针对特定任务的微调模型中. 我们评价DirectSwap(Wang等人,2025年)在其释放的推论管道中,包括其基于注意力的背景堆肥。 对于这个无遮罩模型,我们定义了从第一个去诺步骤的参考意向质量的编辑查询,平均在所有关注头上:在8–26层(零基)的每一层中,如果其质量高于其潜在框架的0.7个四分位数,则一个查询会投出一票,如果这些层中有20%以上的人投了票,则是一个编辑查询。 这些是DirectSwap发布的背景组合掩码的默认值,因此RefGAP没有加自己的阈值. 第一步是未经修改的,然后是固定的,其余的30个取样步骤中有29个是15至29层的。

blocks.en: Appendix G Attribute trade-offs and failure analysis

blocks.en: In head swapping, keypoint degradation is concentrated in JoyAI-Video-Edit, FLUX.2-klein, and FLUX.2-klein-base, whereas face-swap keypoint error increases on most approaches. This difference partly reflects the face-swap evaluation protocol, in which the output is compared with the input geometry while being encouraged to adopt the reference identity. We first disentangle this identity-geometry confound and show that the remaining keypoint and expression costs are concentrated in the same three approaches as in head swapping. We then examine whether delaying the attention correction reduces these costs. Finally, we analyze the background-replacement failure of Qwen-Image-Edit and the occasional blurred-face failures of OmniGen2.
blocks.zh: 在头部互换中,键点降解主要集中在JoyAI-Video-Edit,FLUX.2-klein,和FLUX.2-klein-base,而大多数方法的面部互换键点错误增加. 这一差异部分反映了面部拓扑评价协议,其中在鼓励采用参考身份的同时,将输出与输入几何进行对比. 我们首先将这种身份-地理学混淆起来,表明剩下的关键点和表达成本集中在与头部交换相同的三种方法上。 然后,我们审查推迟关注是否减少这些费用。 最后,我们分析了Quen-Image-Edit的背景替换失败和OmniGen2偶尔模糊的面部失败.

blocks.en: FF++ does not provide ground-truth edited frames, so face-swap keypoints are evaluated against the driving input rather than the reference identity. Although the landmarks are scale-normalized, they remain sensitive to identity-specific face shape. Consequently, successful identity transfer can increase keypoint error even when the input pose is preserved.
blocks.zh: FF++不提供地面真实编辑的帧,因此face-swap键点会根据驱动输入而不是参考身份来评价. 虽然地标是规模化的常态化的,但对身份特异性的面部形状仍然敏感. 因此,即使保留了输入的姿势,成功的身份转移也可能增加关键点错误。

blocks.en: To quantify this effect, table 18 relates the clip-level change in keypoint error to the corresponding identity gain. For Qwen-Image-Edit, LoomVideo, and OmniGen2, the increase in keypoint error is concentrated among clips with large identity gains: their lowest-gain quartiles have near-zero or negative changes, and only small costs remain when | Δ ​ ID | < 0.05 |\Delta\mathrm{ID}|<0.05 . These patterns are consistent with identity-related geometry changes contributing to the measured keypoint increase.

Together with the smaller residual increase on FLUX.2-klein, this matches the approach-level pattern observed in head swapping, where a ground-truth target removes the identity confound. After accounting for identity gain, keypoint degradation is likewise concentrated in these three approaches. blocks.en: G.2 Denoising-step interventions
blocks.zh: G.2 逐步干预

blocks.en: We next test whether the geometric cost can be reduced by delaying the attention correction. The full denoising trajectory is preserved; the correction is disabled only during selected initial steps.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们测试几何成本是否可以通过延迟注意力修正来降低. 完全去声轨迹保留;修正只在选定的初始步骤中禁用。

blocks.en: As shown in table 19 , skipping the first step reduces keypoint error from 0.085 0.085 to 0.052 0.052 on JoyAI-Video-Edit and from 0.153 0.153 to 0.101 0.101 on FLUX.2-klein. These improvements are accompanied by reductions in identity similarity from 0.644 0.644 to 0.613 0.613 and from 0.790 0.790 to 0.753 0.753 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 如表19所示,跳过第一步,将JoyAI-Video-Edit上的键点误差从0.085 0.085 0.085降至0.052 0.052,FLUX.2-Klein上的键点误差从0.153 0.153降至0.101 0.101。 随着这些改进,身份相似性分别从0.644 0.644降至0.613 0.613,从0.790 0.790降至0.753 0.753。

blocks.en: FLUX.2-klein-base uses a longer, 50 50 -step schedule, for which skipping only the first step has little effect. Skipping the first ten steps reduces keypoint error from 0.236 0.236 to 0.183 0.183 , but also lowers identity similarity from 0.799 0.799 to 0.735 0.735 .
blocks.zh: FLUX.2-klein-base使用更长,50-50步的进度表,对此只跳过第一步几乎没有效果. 跳过前十步可以将键点错误从0.236 0.236 0.183 0.183 降低到0.183 0.183 ,但也降低了身份相似度,从0.799 0.799 0.735 0.735 0.735.

blocks.en: Thus, delaying the correction can partially preserve input geometry, but at the cost of weaker identity transfer. Because this trade-off depends on the approach and sampling schedule, we retain correction at all steps to prioritize recognizable reference identity.
blocks.zh: 因此,延迟校正可以部分保留输入几何,但以较弱的身份传递为代价. 由于这种权衡取决于方法和取样时间表,我们保留了所有步骤的校正,以优先确定可识别的参考身份。

blocks.en: G.3 Background replacement failure
blocks.zh: G.3 背景替换失败

blocks.en: Background replacement differs from head swapping, face swapping, and virtual try-on: the reference specifies the surrounding scene rather than the person or their appearance, while the person must be preserved. This shift in the role of the reference may affect how an approach responds to stronger reference conditioning.
blocks.zh: 背景替换与头部互换,面部互换,以及虚拟尝试不同:参考文献指定了周围的场景而不是人物或其外观,而人物必须保存. 这种参考作用的转变可能影响一种方法如何响应更强的参考条件。

blocks.en: On Qwen-Image-Edit, the shared setting reduces DINO from 0.299 to 0.042. Restricting correction to the second half does not recover fidelity on the diagnostic clips. A fixed edit-side bias of b = 2.0 b=2.0 also produces a similar degradation, indicating that the failure is not specific to adaptive edit-side strength (See table 20 ).
blocks.zh: 在Quen-Image-Edit上,共享设置将DINO从0.299减少到0.042. 将校正限制在下半段并不能恢复诊断片段的忠诚。 b = 2.0 b = 2.0的固定编辑侧偏差也会产生类似的退化,表明失败并非专门针对适应性编辑侧强度(见表20).

blocks.zh: 表20:替代设置下的Quen-Image-Edit背景替换. 诊断片段是150个150-clip列表中的第一个30个,没有根据结果选择.

blocks.en: Other approaches improve on this task, so the task difference alone does not explain the failure. The results suggest an approach-dependent limitation when transferring the correction from person-related edits to scene replacement; its underlying cause remains unresolved.
blocks.zh: 其他方法在这项任务上有所改进,因此任务差异本身并不能解释失败的原因. 结果表明,在将更正从与人有关的编辑转移到场景替换时,有依赖方法的限制;其根本原因仍未解决。

blocks.en: G.4 Rare head-swap collapses
blocks.zh: G.4 稀有头部擦碎

blocks.en: OmniGen2 occasionally produces missing or heavily smeared faces in both the base and RefGAP settings. Screening followed by manual inspection identifies 3 / 1040 3/1040 such outputs for the base and 8 / 1040 8/1040 for RefGAP, indicating an existing failure mode that becomes more frequent under the correction. As shown in fig. 4 , changing the sampling seed can recover plausible faces, while repeating the same seed reproduces the failure.
blocks.zh: OmniGen2偶尔会在基部和RefGAP的设置中产生缺失或严重涂抹的面孔. 筛选后进行人工检查,确定基地的这种产出为3 / 1040 3/1040,FRIGAP的这种产出为8 / 1040 8/1040,这表明在校正下,现有的故障模式变得更加常见。 如无明所显示. 4,改变采样种子可以恢复假面,而重复同样的种子则复制失败.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Seed sensitivity of OmniGen2 head-swap outputs. Columns show the reference, input, base, RefGAP at seed 0 0 , a repeat at the same seed, and three alternative seeds. Repeated seeds reproduce the failures, while alternative seeds can recover plausible faces.
blocks.zh: 图4:OmniGen2头部擦拭输出的种子敏感性. 列显示参考,输入,基数,RefGAP在0号种子时显示,重复在同一种子时显示,并显示三个替代种子. 重复播种的种子复制失败,而替代种子则可以恢复假面貌。
